FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Pedal Power Bicycle Shop, we specialize in the retail of high-quality bicycles and cycling accessories, serving our local community with a strong emphasis on personalized customer service. Our operations are centered around our physical storefront located in Springfield, where customers can browse our diverse selection of bikes, from road and mountain to hybrid models. We also offer a full range of professional repair services, provided by our well-trained technicians, all of whom have documented expertise in bicycle mechanics. 

Our business strictly adheres to all local, state, and federal regulations and maintains necessary licensing while ensuring that all our employees participate in ongoing training and safety protocols. To protect our inventory and provide a safe shopping environment, we have established comprehensive security measures, including surveillance cameras and alarm systems. 

We value community engagement and occasionally participate in local events, ensuring that all activities have defined risk management controls. Our focus remains on creating a safe and inviting atmosphere for all cycling enthusiasts, reinforcing our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.
